dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| where isnotempty(ioc) and (isnull(is_whitelisted) or tobool(is_whitelisted) == false)
| extend IocType = tolower(tostring(ioc_type))
| extend ObservableKey = case(
    IocType == 'ipv4', 'ipv4-addr:value',
    IocType == 'ipv6', 'ipv6-addr:value',
    IocType == 'domain', 'domain-name:value',
    IocType == 'url', 'url:value',
    IocType == 'email', 'email-addr:value',
    IocType == 'filehash-md5', 'file:hashes.MD5',
    IocType == 'filehash-sha1', "file:hashes.'SHA-1'",
    IocType == 'filehash-sha256', "file:hashes.'SHA-256'",
    '')
| where isnotempty(ObservableKey)
| extend RawValue = replace(@"^\s+|\s+$", "", tostring(ioc))
| extend ObservableValue = iff(IocType == 'url', RawValue, tolower(RawValue))
| extend FirstSeen = datetime(1970-01-01) + tolong(first_seen) * 1sec
| extend LastSeen = datetime(1970-01-01) + tolong(last_seen) * 1sec
| extend TimeGenerated = now()
| extend ValidFrom = iff(isnull(FirstSeen), now(), FirstSeen)
| extend Modified = iff(isnull(LastSeen), now(), LastSeen)
| extend ValidUntil = datetime_add('day', 30, Modified)
| extend Created = ValidFrom
| extend Confidence = risk_score
| extend Labels = iff(isnull(behaviour_tags), parse_json('[]'), behaviour_tags), Malware = related_malware, ThreatActors = related_threat_actors
| extend MalwareText = replace(@'[\[\]"]', '', tostring(Malware)), ThreatActorsText = replace(@'[\[\]"]', '', tostring(ThreatActors))
| extend patternValue = replace(@"'", @"\\'", replace(@"\\", @"\\\\", ObservableValue))
| extend Pattern = strcat("[", ObservableKey, " = '", patternValue, "']")
| extend idHex = substring(tostring(hash_sha256(strcat('CybleVisionIOC|', ObservableKey, '|', ObservableValue))), 0, 32)
| extend Id = strcat('indicator--', substring(idHex, 0, 8), '-', substring(idHex, 8, 4), '-', substring(idHex, 12, 4), '-', substring(idHex, 16, 4), '-', substring(idHex, 20, 12))
| extend SourceSystem = 'CybleVisionIOC'
| extend LastUpdateMethod = 'Cyble Vision IOC CCF'
| extend IsActive = true, IsDeleted = false, Revoked = false
| extend AdditionalFields = pack('iocType', tostring(ioc_type), 'riskScore', risk_score, 'confidenceRating', confidence_rating, 'sources', sources, 'behaviourTags', Labels, 'targetCountries', target_countries, 'targetRegions', target_regions, 'targetIndustries', target_industries, 'relatedMalware', Malware, 'relatedThreatActors', ThreatActors, 'firstSeen', FirstSeen, 'lastSeen', LastSeen)
| extend Data = pack('type', 'indicator', 'spec_version', '2.1', 'id', Id, 'created', Created, 'modified', Modified, 'name', ObservableValue, 'description', strcat('Cyble Vision IOC (', tostring(ioc_type), '), risk score ', tostring(risk_score), ', confidence ', tostring(confidence_rating), iff(isnotempty(MalwareText), strcat(', malware: ', MalwareText), ''), iff(isnotempty(ThreatActorsText), strcat(', threat actors: ', ThreatActorsText), '')),'indicator_types', pack_array('malicious-activity'), 'pattern', Pattern, 'pattern_type', 'stix', 'valid_from', ValidFrom, 'valid_until', ValidUntil, 'confidence', Confidence, 'labels', Labels)
| project TimeGenerated, Id, ObservableKey, ObservableValue, Pattern, SourceSystem, Confidence, IsActive, IsDeleted, Revoked, ValidFrom, ValidUntil, Created, Modified, LastUpdateMethod, AdditionalFields, Data
